name: Eliphalel
title: One of David's Mighty Warriors
summary: Eliphalel, son of Ur, is mentioned as one of David's mighty warriors in 1 Chronicles. He belonged to the elite group of heroes who served King David with great bravery and loyalty. He is one of the less well-known warriors, but his inclusion on the list testifies to his significant contribution to David's military forces.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among David's Heroes
keyEvents.description: Eliphalel, son of Ur, is listed among David's mighty men in 1 Chronicles, a list of the brave warriors who supported David throughout his reign.

keyEvents.title: Deeds of David's Mighty Men
keyEvents.description: The list of David's heroes in 1 Chronicles 11 describes a group of elite warriors who performed great feats and remained loyal to David from the beginning of his kingdom.

keyEvents.title: David's Heroes Gather
keyEvents.description: David's mighty men gathered around him and strengthened his kingdom in accordance with the Lord's word over Israel.

keyEvents.title: Parallel list in 2 Samuel
keyEvents.description: A corresponding list of David's heroes is found in 2 Samuel 23, although some names vary between the two lists. Eliphel is mentioned specifically in Chronicles' version.
